items.source: The application is ready to receive traffic.
items.translation: 应用程序已准备好接收流量。

items.source: The application is not willing to receive traffic.
items.translation: 该应用程序不愿接收流量。

items.source: An application is considered ready when it's live and willing to accept traffic. "Readiness" failure means that the application is not able to accept traffic and that the infrastructure should stop routing requests to it.
items.translation: 当应用程序处于 live 状态且愿意接受流量时，即被视为就绪。 “就绪”失败意味着应用程序无法接受流量，基础设施应停止向其路由请求。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name. The string must match exactly an identifier used to declare an enum constant in this class. (Extraneous whitespace characters are not permitted.)
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。该字符串必须与用于在此类中声明枚举常量的标识符完全匹配。（不允许存在多余的空白字符。）
